description: Fixed public standard API token-price snapshot for usage estimates, not an invoice.
assumptions: No runtime price lookups. Each run preserves its pricing snapshot.
Standard synchronous inference; excludes fast mode, priority, batch/flex discounts, regional premiums, negotiated discounts, taxes, subscriptions and non-token tool charges.
Cache-write rates are total rates for those tokens, not surcharges added to ordinary input.
Reasoning/thinking tokens are billed at output rates; use provider usage counters without counting included reasoning twice.
Gemini introductory rates are frozen in this snapshot. Google advertises input/cache-read/output rates of 4/0.20/20 USD per million starting 2026-12-01.

gpt-6-astra.notes: Input counts include cache reads and writes. A request above the threshold uses the higher rates for its entire input and output.

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Standard rates across the full 1M context. Input, cache-read and cache-write counters are separate. Output includes thinking.

gemini-4-argon-medium.notes: Implicit caching only; explicit cache writes are unsupported. No context price tier is published. Local agy models lists the low, medium and high variants as Gemini 4 Argon; official docs identify the canonical model and these thinking levels.
